messages:
noah_sales: OrchID Health asking for a HIPAA POC. Traffic: baseline ~220 qps, scheduled daily morning spikes ~700 qps (5-8m), occasional random blips to ~1k. Need reserved sizing, preheat steps, autoscale snippet, and a conditional p99 SLA for the SOW by EOD Mon.

eva_eng: Quick clarifier: are the morning spikes deterministic (cron) or user-driven? If deterministic we can stagger preheat to save cost.

noah_sales: Mostly deterministic 08:00-08:08 local, but they warned about ad-hoc campaign blasts.

eva_eng: Perf estimate: at ~70 tokens, our standard A100 nodes do ~260 qps/GPU. For 700 peak reserve 3 GPUs (gives ~780 qps). For occasional 1k blips add burst_pool=2. Recommend reserved_gpus=3 + burst_credits=2.

sophia_sre: Agree. KV shards = 6 (2 per GPU). Preheat plan: stagger warmups in 3 waves starting 20m prior, finishing 5m before peak to keep caches fresh. AZ spread: 2 AZs for the POC.

ben_prod: Fallback model: gpt-small-int8 to stay online under heavy load; expected p99 ~400-700ms in fallback. Routing: reserved -> burst -> degraded_shared. We'll add telemetry to flag quality drift during fallback.

maria_ops: Ops knobs: global_rate_limit:1200qps, max_queue_depth:500. Add fair-queueing by customer id to prevent hotspotting and a shedding policy that drops non-PII background requests first. Preheat CLI for docs:

```
redwood preheat --project orchid-poc --model gpt-med-quant --shards 6 --duration 20m --stagger 60s --warm_weights true
```

eva_eng: Autoscale YAML snippet for SOW (short):

```
autoscale:
  reserved_gpus: "3"
  burst_credits: "2"
  preheat_minutes: "20"
  kv_shards: "6"
  az_spread: "2"
  scale_up:
    policy: "fast"
    target_util_percent: "60"
    cooldown_s: "15"
  scale_down:
    policy: "controlled"
    grace_s: "180"
  degraded_model: "gpt-small-int8"
```

sophia_sre: SLA blurb: "Redwood commits to p99 < 240ms when serving from reserved capacity (reserved_gpus=3) with KV warmed and no eviction. Serving from burst credits or degraded model may increase p99 to ~400-700ms. SOW will include explicit rollback triggers and measured fallback periods."

legal_joy: For HIPAA we need their security questionnaire, BAA acceptance, KMS (customer-managed supported), audit logs >=90 days, and VPC/PrivateLink options. Noah, forward the questionnaire and I'll mark required answers.

maria_ops: Runbook triggers proposal: if p99 > 300ms for 90s -> page oncall; if sustained > 400ms for 2m -> auto-failover to degraded_model + notify customer; manual override to disable preheat to save cost.

ben_prod: Also include a brief note about model quantization: using int8 reduces cost but may change output behaviour; we'll run a small eval set during POC preheat to sanity-check outputs.

preheat-bot: Preheat placeholder scheduled: orchid-poc / preheat / 2025-02-03T07:40Z :white_check_mark:

noah_sales: Great. I'll package reserved_gpus:3, burst_credits:2, preheat:20m, autoscale YAML, SLA caveat, runbook triggers, and legal checklist into the SOW and send to OrchID. Will DM legal the questionnaire now. Thanks team :pray:
